scope.title: Ordivon Security v2
scope.description: External-first security verification and authority/admission semantic waist for Ordivon.

description: Security v2 composes external scanners, policy, signing, runtime and virtualization providers while retaining exact subject/evidence binding, authority/admission and verified-consequence semantics.

trust_zones.title: Engineering and Security Policy
trust_zones.description: Version-controlled Security v2 source, policy and threat model.

trust_zones.title: Trusted Local Execution
trust_zones.description: Ordivon Runtime and locally admitted execution providers.

trust_zones.title: External Provider Boundary
trust_zones.description: External scanners, repositories and security providers whose outputs are evidence, not Ordivon authority.

actors.title: Authorized operator
actors.description: Human or higher-level owner supplying exact target and effect authority.
actors.permissions: May request only explicitly authorized verification/effect operations.

actors.title: External security provider
actors.description: Mature external tool or service producing provider-native evidence.
actors.permissions: Produces observations only unless separately admitted for effectful testing.

components.title: Security v2 semantic waist
components.description: Binds exact subjects, evidence digests/currentness/applicability, authority, admission and verified consequence.

components.title: OPA/Rego policy decision point
components.description: Evaluates admission and standing from explicitly supplied evidence and authority context.

components.title: Ordivon Runtime
components.description: Owns exact physical execution/attempt/delivery evidence; does not inherit Security policy authority.

components.title: Temporal
components.description: Owns durable workflow continuity, not security truth.

components.title: External verification providers
components.description: Gitleaks, Semgrep, OSV-Scanner, Trivy, Syft, Scorecard, ZAP, fuzzing and runtime-detection providers as admitted by profile.

components.title: Independent authoritative observer
components.description: Provider/native observation capable of establishing a later consequence independently from the executor receipt.

data_flows.title: Operator to Security
data_flows.description: Exact subject, requested verification/effect and authority context.

data_flows.title: Provider evidence to Security
data_flows.description: Provider-native evidence retained by digest and exact subject binding.

data_flows.title: Security to OPA
data_flows.description: Bound evidence, applicability and authority context for policy evaluation.

data_flows.title: Admitted effect to Runtime
data_flows.description: Only an admitted exact effect is submitted for physical execution.

data_flows.title: Runtime receipt to Security
data_flows.description: Execution receipt is evidence of execution and never self-promotes to verified world consequence.

data_flows.title: Independent observation to Security
data_flows.description: Authoritative observation used to verify consequence against the exact request and post-state digest.

threat_personas.title: Evidence spoofer
threat_personas.description: Adversary or compromised provider attempting to make wrong/stale evidence appear current.

threat_personas.title: Authority boundary confuser
threat_personas.description: Requester attempting to turn reachability or credentials into effect authority.

threats.title: Stale evidence promoted as current
threats.description: Evidence produced for a different architecture/source revision is used for current admission.

threats.title: Reachability confused with authority
threats.description: An effectful scanner or runtime operation is executed merely because the target is reachable or credentials exist.
threats.event: Effectful verification is requested without an exact target grant.

threats.title: Executor self-verifies world consequence
threats.description: An execution receipt is accepted as independent proof that the intended world consequence occurred.
threats.event: Executor returns a successful receipt without independent readback.

controls.title: Exact architecture envelope binding
controls.description: Threat model and retained evidence bind to an exact deterministic architecture-file envelope digest.

controls.title: Explicit effect authority
controls.description: Effectful verification requires exact actor/authority/target/capability admission; credentials and reachability are insufficient.

controls.title: Independent consequence observation
controls.description: Verified consequence requires a later authoritative observation bound to the request and matching post-state digest.

risks.title: Incorrect security admission
risks.description: Stale or spoofed evidence may produce an incorrect current security decision.
risks.impact_description: A subject or effect could be incorrectly trusted or reported as verified.

risks.title: Unauthorized verification effect
risks.description: An active scan or physical operation could affect a target outside granted scope.
risks.impact_description: An undeclared third-party or production target could be modified or disrupted.

ordivon.dev/security/source-binding.modelingMethod: OWASP Threat Model Library schema with STRIDE-compatible analysis; CAPEC/CWE references may be added when applicable
ordivon.dev/security/source-binding.editorStanding: Threat Dragon is a replaceable editor/viewer, not the authority format
